grammar.purpose: Signal uncertainty and an unwelcome possibility
grammar.explanation: 大概六点到 is an estimate, not a guarantee. 恐怕要下雨 often presents an unwelcome possibility politely; it is not simply the verb 害怕. Neither adverb proves the event occurred. 大约 estimates an amount or time; avoid silently upgrading any estimate to a confirmed appointment.

examples.py: tā dà gài liù diǎn dào .
examples.en: She will probably arrive at six.
I am afraid it may rain.

examples.py: dà gài huì lái , dàn hái méi què rèn .
examples.en: She will probably come, but it is not confirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 大概六点到，就是保证六点到。
commonMistakes.why: An estimate does not guarantee an exact time.

grammar.explanation: 要是下雨，就在室内见 states what to do under a condition, without asserting that the condition will occur. 就 belongs with the resulting plan. Use 如果 similarly, and distinguish a hypothetical consequence from a report of an event that has already happened.

examples.py: yào shì xià yǔ , jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .

examples.zh: 要是她还没到，我们就先发消息。
examples.py: yào shì tā hái méi dào , wǒ men jiù xiān fā xiāo xī .
examples.en: If she has not arrived, we will message first.

examples.zh: 要是地点关了，就换一个。
examples.py: yào shì dì diǎn guān le , jiù huàn yī gè .
examples.en: If the venue is closed, change it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 要是下雨，所以已经取消了。
commonMistakes.right: 要是下雨，就改在室内见。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the conditional plan separate from a completed cancellation.

lines.zh: 你大概几点到？
lines.py: nǐ dà gài jǐ diǎn dào ?
lines.en: About what time will you arrive?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 预计六点，路上大约二十分钟。
lines.py: yù jì liù diǎn , lù shàng dà yuē èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: I expect six; the journey takes about twenty minutes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 恐怕下午要下雨。我们取消吗？
lines.py: kǒng pà xià wǔ yào xià yǔ . wǒ men qǔ xiāo ma ?
lines.en: I am afraid it may rain this afternoon. Should we cancel?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不必马上取消。要是下雨，就在室内见。
lines.py: bù bì mǎ shàng qǔ xiāo . yào shì xià yǔ , jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .
lines.en: No need to cancel immediately. If it rains, meet indoors.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 室内地点已经定了吗？
lines.py: shì nèi dì diǎn yǐ jīng dìng le ma ?
lines.en: Is the indoor venue already settled?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没有。我先确认，再告诉你。
lines.py: hái méi yǒu . wǒ xiān què rèn , zài gào sù nǐ .
lines.en: Not yet. I will confirm it and then tell you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我仍然希望见面。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ réng rán xī wàng jiàn miàn .
lines.en: Okay; I still hope we can meet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也是。愿望有了，地点还要查。
lines.py: wǒ yě shì . yuàn wàng yǒu le , dì diǎn hái yào chá .
lines.en: Me too. We have the wish; the venue still needs checking.
lines.speaker: b
